title: Windowed SLO allocator with KV hotspot attenuation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Under steady-state continuous batching, tenant requests with bursty hot keys cause uneven KV cache pressure and GPU memory churn. This leads to tail latency violations for SLO-bound tenants when the serving node spends time evicting and re-populating KV working sets. Goal: implement a windowed SLO allocator that assigns time-sliced lease tokens to tenants, uses short-term quantile estimates of per-tenant latency and token consumption, and attenuates KV hotspot pressure via probabilistic micro-eviction and short-lived snapshots. The allocator should preserve throughput for best-effort workloads while protecting P0/P1 SLOs and minimizing overall GPU memory fragmentation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New allocator can be enabled behind a runtime feature flag and defaults to off
2) For a mixed-tenancy synthetic workload (50 tenants, 10% P0, 20% P1, rest P2/P3) with injected KV-hot keys, P0 99th percentile tail latency improves by at least 25% vs baseline under same QPS
3) GPU memory churn (tracked by page-fault-like metric) reduces by >= 30% on hotspot-heavy runs
4) No regression (>5%) in overall throughput for default request mixes
5) Unit and integration tests covering lease rotation, slot preemption, and KV snapshot/restore paths are added
6) Observability: per-tenant window utilization, eviction counts, and slot-lease churn are exposed in Console dashboards
comments: 2025-01-28 Maya Chen: Initial triage. Observed production noise on nodes serving bursty RLHF sketch workloads. Proposed windowed allocator to reduce KV thrash and provide predictable per-tenant latency budgets.

2025-01-30 Aisha Patel: Scoped implementation: lease manager + short rolling snapshot per tenant + attenuation policy with exponential backoff on re-population frequency. Plan to prototype in canary cluster.

2025-02-02 Design review (Jonas Müller): Requested more detail on eviction hysteresis and on-disk snapshot format; flagged potential interaction with Dedicated autoscaler. Action: add explicit hysteresis counters and align snapshot size caps.

2025-02-05 Eng review (Omar Novak): Proposed using quantile window of 30s and slot size of 200ms by default. Raised risk: increased scheduler complexity and lock contention on per-tenant metadata. Mitigation: use sharded lease maps and lock-free stats where possible.

2025-02-07 Aisha Patel: Implemented prototype lease rotation and basic KV snapshot API. Added simulation harness in runtime/sim to replay mixed-tenancy traces. Early sim results: 18% tail latency reduction for P0; KV churn reduced ~22% on synthetic hotspots.

2025-02-09 Maya Chen: Decided to add probabilistic micro-eviction: when a tenant's hotset exceeds threshold, evict a small fraction (1-3%) of least-recently-used KV shards instead of full purge — reduces rebuild cost while giving breathing room for other tenants.

2025-02-11 QA (Priya Rao): Integration run in staging with real traffic sample. Observed slot-lease contention when slot config set too small; updated default slot to 300ms and increased window to 45s. No customer-facing errors seen.

2025-02-12 Aisha Patel: Opening PR for feature flag gating and dashboard metrics. Next: end-to-end load test in Canary region with canary traffic shaping and SLO telemetry collection. Follow-up tasks created for Dedicated autoscaler integration and security review for snapshot persistence.
